title: When the Vow Wakes
author: F. M. Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Halloran, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
